scene.ko: 회식 자리에서 동료가 마라톤 이야기를 궁금해하자, 달리기를 시작한 이유와 경험을 나누고 상대에게도 질문을 돌린다.

lines.en: I heard you ran a marathon last month. Is that true?
Ha, word gets around! Yeah, it was my first full one.
lines.ko: 하하, 소문 빠르네요! 네, 풀코스는 처음이었어요.
alt: Ha, news travels fast! Yes, it was my first full marathon.
Yeah, it's true. It was my first full marathon.

lines.en: That's amazing. I can barely run for a bus. What got you into running?
lines.ko: 대단하네요. 저는 버스 타려고 뛰는 것도 힘든데. 어쩌다 달리기를 시작했어요?

lines.en: Honestly, it started during a really stressful year at work. Running was the only time my head felt clear.
lines.ko: 솔직히 회사에서 정말 힘들었던 해에 시작했어요. 달릴 때만 머리가 맑아지더라고요.
alt: To be honest, I started during a very stressful year at work. When I ran, my mind finally felt clear.

lines.en: I get that. But doesn't it get boring, running for hours?
lines.ko: 이해돼요. 그래도 몇 시간씩 달리면 지루하지 않아요?

lines.en: You'd think so, but it's actually the opposite. I listen to podcasts, and I notice things around the neighborhood I never saw before.
lines.ko: 그럴 것 같죠? 그런데 오히려 반대예요. 팟캐스트도 듣고, 동네에서 전엔 못 보던 것들이 눈에 들어와요.
alt: It sounds boring, but it really isn't. I listen to podcasts and discover new things around my neighborhood.

lines.en: Okay, now you're almost making me want to try it.
lines.ko: 와, 듣다 보니 저도 좀 해 보고 싶어지려고 하네요.

lines.en: Ha, I won't push you! But if you're ever curious, there's a beginner group that meets by the river on Saturdays.
lines.ko: 하하, 강요는 안 할게요! 그래도 혹시 궁금하면, 토요일마다 강가에서 모이는 초보자 모임이 있어요.
alt: I won't pressure you! But if you're ever interested, a beginner group runs by the river every Saturday.

lines.en: I'll think about it. Maybe after I buy some real running shoes.
lines.ko: 생각해 볼게요. 제대로 된 운동화부터 사고요.

lines.en: Sounds like a plan. So what about you, Chris? What do you do to unwind?
lines.ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 그럼 크리스 씨는요? 쉴 때 뭐 하면서 풀어요?
alt: Good plan. And you? How do you relax after work?
Sounds good. What about you? What do you do to unwind?

expressions.note: 상대의 예상과 다르다고 부드럽게 말할 때

expressions.en: What do you do to unwind?
expressions.note: unwind = 긴장을 풀다 · 대화를 상대에게 넘길 때
